reviews.comment: Dr. G is amazing and as long as you put in effort he will take care of you. I couldn't recommend him more.
The quizzes can be difficult. As long as you go to class and do your homework/non-test portion of the grade on time you should have a decent buffer making the tests doable.

Chem 107 is a tough course given its pacing, but I thought Dr. G did a great job teaching. The lectures did sometimes feel rushed and stressful, especially with iClicker used in every class, but Dr. G made sure to help if people were not understanding content. He also posted videos of him working through reviews and practice exams.

In addition to teaching clearly, he makes videos that clearly explain exam problems. Sometimes, he ends class early. He occasionally shows derivations, good for students who enjoy them. He's somehow adept at Gen Z humor. He replaces your lowest exam grade. Homework is due weekly. Exams are MCQ. The textbook is helpful, but not necessary to learn.

I had Dr G. for 119 & 258 and he's one of the best professors I've had because he really cares about his students and wants the best for them. He puts a lot of time/effort into each of his classes, making everything accessible and easy to navigate. His OrgTube videos are incredibly helpful for understanding the material and include so much practice

Although I took AP CHEM in HS, I still struggled in this course. Ghanbaripour is a good professor, but make sure to study frequently, put in the work, and find a study group for this course. He goes through slides quickly, and it material can be difficult to understand at times. There are iclickers, about 6 quizzes, and 2 mid terms, and a final.

I had Dr G. for 119 + 258 and he's one of the best professors l've had because he really cares about his students and wants the best for them. He puts a lot of time/effort into each of his classes, making everything accessible and easy to navigate. His OrgTube videos are incredibly helpful for understanding the material and include so much practice

Has a youtube channel where you can learn everything from and is identical to what you see on exams. He is very funny, but also teaches well and gives extra credit. Lab is fine as long as you pay attention in class. Also curved us down to an 87 for an A which was very nice. Overall, probably the best professor I have taken at A&M. Take Dr. G.

I had Dr. G for 119 + 258 and he's one of the best profs I've had, as he really cares about his students and wants the best for them. He truly puts a lot of time/effort into each of his classes, making everything accessible and easy to navigate. His OrgTube videos are incredibly helpful for understanding the material and include so much practice.

I had Dr G. for 119 + 258 and he's one of the best professors I've had because he really cares about his students and wants the best for them. He puts a lot of time/effort into each of his classes, making everything accessible and easy to navigate. His OrgTube videos are incredibly helpful for understanding the material and include so much practice

Overall a great professor who genuinely wants students to succeed. Letter grade cutoffs were lowered by 3 points, so an A was 87, B was 77, and so on.      Wish other professors were like him, the GOAT.      His YouTube channel, OrgTube, is a great resource to preview material

This was Dr.G's first time teaching CHEM222. He did change certain things in order to help students, and even adjusted tests/powerpoints in order to help us. He's way better than the other Chem222 prof. Very helpful, and cared about his students. He did iclicker everyday, but rounded it up after a certain cutoff.TAKE HIM!

A little overrated imo. His YT videos are incredible but his lectures can be boring and unorganized. His practice tests are very similar to his actual tests, and an A was an 87 which I greatly appreciated. I'm sure he's a great 119 lecturer but 258 is just a different playing field, but getting an A is very doable. Good luck!

Really funny, amazing guy. Tests are easier than other professors, drops lowest quiz and gave extra credit for giving a class review. Great to talk to as well. Sometimes accent can be a bit hard to understand.

The G in Dr. G stands for GOAT. He explains difficult concepts very clearly using good analogies and you can tell he really loves this subject. He's also funny and keeps his lectures light and not too serious, and he's easy to talk to and ask questions. Genuinely got me through freshman year chem

Dr. G is the great chem professor. The material is decently difficult, and is VERY FAST PACED if you've never taken an honors chemistry / AP chemistry. Just show up to every class, make sure you understand and can apply concepts mathematically, and do the practice exams he gives right before exams. You'll do fine! Absolutely take him.

Professor was very hard to work with in my case. Content was very very difficult if you didn't take AP Chem in high school, and professor was not helpful at all. The only way to pass this class is by learning the content yourself, the professor in my opinion did not teach well at all. I only went to class was because it was 10% of my grade

Mr. G is a great and very funny professor. I didn't take AP Chem, so I was worried at first, but his lectures are clear and helpful. The quizzes are harder than the exams, so don't stress if you get a 60, as I did on one of them; however, they prepare you well. He provides great videos and test reviews. This is the professor you want for this class

Dr. G is an amazing professor. His classes are entertaining, and as long as you can give him your full attention during the lectures, passing is doable. His quizzes can be hard and demand studying, but they make the tests feel easier.
Amazing professor. I did not take AP Chem but managed to get an A due to his lectures. Make sure to be willing to also put in effort from your end. Hilarious professor.

I loved him as a professor. And even though I didn't pass his class by like two points, he still taught me a lot. Also he is very strict when it comes to late grades and rounding up grades. His test are very similar to test reviews so make sure to study those. The quizzes are what gets you the most.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Honestly, a great professor, couldn't have asked for better. The last time I covered these concepts was in sophomore year of HS, but I had no problem reviewing and relearning topics through his lectures. The SI sessions are helpful, especially before quizzes. His test reviews heavily reflect the actual exam. If you can, take him.

Love Dr G! He is a teacher that actually cares for the students. he doesn't care that this is a weed out class. His quizzes are hard but the exams are very easy. And he drops your lowest quiz grade. And his youtube channel is amazing as well

Top tier professor for chemistry. My only gripe was that some of the slides were a bit confusing, but the videos were really good for clearing up most of my questions. The exams were on the easier side, while the quizzes were a bit harder. Professor G is a very caring professor and was one of my best professors this fall semester.
Take the time to watch his videos and review lecture notes before and after going to class. Study hard for the tests and you can get an A.

Dr. G's lectures are relevant, and he is an engaging and funny professor. His office hours are really helpful. Never miss an exam because the makeup exam is much worse. If you do the course evaluation, you get an extra 5 bonus points on the final exam, which averages with your lowest test grade. His office hours are quite helpful.

Dr. G was a decent professor. I was often stressed because I wasn't always sure what to focus on. I found the homework and quizzes (15% of the grade) harder than the exams. The test reviews before each exam were very helpful. I relied a lot on outside resources to learn the material.

Best professor for Chem-107. Very clear for what the exams should look like, and is very flexible with all the grades. Cares about students and wants to see success. Sometimes unclear with lectures, but provides videos to ensure clarity.

Dr. G is a great professor. Although he lectures a bit quickly, he truly cares about teaching and even makes his own videos and reviews that are extremely helpful for quizzes and exams. Glad I had him as my professor.
He was a good prof, just pay attention to the lectures and you should be fine.

Great prof, definitely cared about his students. 107 was tough since I didn't take AP chem, but Dr G did everything he could to boost our grades, including extending quiz deadlines if we had exams for other classes that day, or 5 extra points on our final exam, which I'm pretty sure he was the only 107 prof to do so. Occasional 67 joke in lectures.
Chill prof, tends to skip over stuff sometimes, but if you've taken AP Chem in HS before you'll be fine. Quizzes can be a bit hard, but as long as you do well on the exams you can still get an A.

Dr. G is hands down one of the best teachers I've ever had. He teaches the material really well and manages to make complicated topics seem clear as day! He does have a pretty thick accent, personally it didn't bother me but some might struggle understanding it. He's an amazing prof which makes up for it imo. TAKE DR. G IF YOU CAN!!

His first time teaching the course was Fall 2025, so he didn't have multiple past exams for extra practice only 1 or 2 in total. He isn't a very clear lecturer, so expect to watch his videos or other videos on your own time to truly understand. Quizzes are way harder than the actual exams but the lowest quiz gets dropped. Nice guy, gives extra help

Dr. G is amazing. He was clear with his expectations for each exam and announced when topics would not be tested. He lowered the "A" cutoff to an 87 and had the final replace the lowest exam grade. This class requires a lot of studying due to memorization, but his exams are fair and his YouTube videos are helpful. He is also a very funny prof.

Dr. G is literally the goat. Bro has me cackling during lecture, and often uses analogies to let concepts stick to your head. His main shining point though are his test reviews and exams. Exams follow somewhat closely to the test review (you cant rely on this only though) and if you can do the all the lecture examples cold you will be fine.
Overall Dr. G was a great teacher the material can just be hard at times.
While the class is content heavy, the resources provided and abundant lectures w/ fun analogies makes the topics memorable and applicable when following along.

Absolutely great professor! He knows what he's talking about and takes students' opinions into account. OChem is just a hard class, but he helps make it digestible. Not a pushover, but genuinely cares about his students and has a great personality! Uses iClicker (70%< gets full credit), Aktiv HW (90%< gets full credit). Very exam heavy!

Chemistry GOAT. Not the greatest lecturer, but he does have a Youtube channel where he goes over topics learned in class. Definitely try to get good grades on the first two exams, as he kind of skimmed over the last third of the class. Quizzes were kind of hard, but exams were easier than other profs. Study hard and this class should be an easy A.

Jam-packed slides with completely unnecessary information, drowning out important content. Very unresponsive to emails; tells you not to email him altogether. Will NOT work with you regarding due dates/excused absences, regardless of the severity of the extenuating personal circumstances.

Hands down the CHEM 107 GOAT. Very caring and receptive to questions, iClicker is an easy grade booster. His exams are way easier than other profs, and he gives a review for them (final included) that matches the real thing perfectly. Quizzes are insanely difficult, but those are designed by the department and not Dr G, so study hard for them.

Good professor. He lectures fast and sometimes skims over things, and his accent can be difficult to understand at times, but great overall. Exams are relatively easy (especially compared to the quizzes) and are extremely similar to the reviews incl. final), and his YouTube videos are super helpful.

This professor is difficult to work around. If you must miss an exam, he will make the make-up exam significantly harder; the average will be 25 points lower, and he will not curve it. Aside from that, there were many instances where he set hard deadlines and would accept absolutely no excuses, even university-accepted ones.

Funny professor, does a great job at teaching such a large class, lectures are as interesting as they can be. Class itself isn't too hard, basically like AP Chem, just moves faster. The quizzes are a little harder but the exams are pretty easy and if you do the hw and take notes on the lecture slides you'll know how to do everything on the exams.

The professor's lectures are great and sometimes entertaining. The class uses iClicker for attendance and assessing understanding and Cengage WebAssign for hw. The quizzes (free response and mcq) are harder than the exams (mcq only). Expect around 6 hours of hw per unit if you have previous experience.
He's a pretty funny dude during lecture. Quizzes seemed way harder than the tests so make sure you study for those.
Overall really great professor. Like any 107 section there's about 1-2 hours of homework a week and iClicker for every lecture.

Take Dr. G for Chem 107! Never took AP Chem but he made it bearable. Tests are WAY easier than quizzes imo, study the review he drops and you'll be fine--basically the same as the test or final. Drops 1 quiz, rounds homework, attendance, and bonus points on the final. Loved him, my goat
Absolutely goated. Incredible lectures and very funny. Class is pretty difficult if you have not taken AP Chemistry in high school but I ended up getting an A, mostly due to having Dr. G.

He is a little hard to understand, but overall a great teacher, the quizzes are hard but the tests are much easier than other professors and he makes the lectures very funny, make sure you dont have to leave early though because he will have I-clickers for the last few seconds of class

Easy class if you took AP Chem. If you didn't, just put in the work, and you will see the results. He is a funny guy and is willing to help you out. 3 Exams, with one of them being a final. He drops one quiz and averages ur lowest exam with the final. iClicker is kind of an L, but it's whatever. Best prof out of all the options imo.

If you have never taken AP Chem you will struggle in this class. I had a hard time following most of his lectures and he hardly has any resources outside his class besides a 10-20 minute video that he posts on canvas. Overall, if you have taken ap chem then your going to be ok, otherwise you have to study a LOT.

Dr. G is such a good professor, he genuinely cares about the students and teaches very well. He moved a couple of our quizzes because he knew there were other exams happening on the same day, so he understands that his class isn't the only class that we're taking. He also has review videos on youtube which are really helpful.

Love Dr G. Overall the best Chemistry teacher here cares about the students and can teach very well. he also has a lot of test review resources like his YouTube channel and office hours. His quizzes are a bit hard but they make the tests very easy. Overall highly recommend him if you want the easiest way to get an A in Chem

Incredible professor. By far my favorite professor this semester! He took a subject I hated in high school and made me look forward to going to his class. He is hilarious, and really cares about his students. Take him if possible!

Incredible professor. By far my favorite professor this semester! He took a subject I hated in high school and made me look forward to going to his class. He is hilarious, and really cares about his students. Take him if possible! Don't skip class, he uses iClicker for attendance and participation.
He was great in all aspects. Yes the class can be hard but you could really tell he cared about his students and as long as you pay attention its not a bad class at all.

The best way to do well in this class is to review the material before lecture ngl. I would have a really hard time getting through lecture due to not having AP chem background and reviewing before class. He goes through lectures quite fast which I also found to be quite hard to follow, you'll either perform well or pretty bad tbh.

There are a lot of concepts in this course, but Dr. G is a G at teaching it. He provides many resources to help you learn and he provides leniency on dates before quizzes and other engineering exams. His exams are much easier than the quizzes but you have to study for them especially if you didn't take AP chem. Attendance mandatory due to iClickers

issues mainly come from bad studying habits and not paying attention in lectures, which is what happened to me until the end of the semester. he will help if needed and is extremely caring when it comes to giving extensions. only other issue is quizzes will not align with lectures or homework due dates.

A caring professor who cares when his students are loaded with exams for other engineering courses--think quiz extensions, iClicker leniency, etc. However, you must pay attention and learn the material, especially if you didn't take AP chem, or you won't do well on exams. Allocate time for homework and studying, as this is an engineering course.

This professor is actually the goat when it comes to giving extensions and not overlapping with other exams that week. If people ask, he actually listens. If your taking it as a prerequisite for engineering, just know that if you didn't take AP chem, you will have to study a lot outside of class though.

A pretty easy Prof when in comparison to the other Chemistry Ones. His tests are significantly easier than other Professors and the review he gives before the test is pretty similar to the one you see on test day. If you do the Homework and lock in on the quizzes your green.

I took Dr. G in Fall of 2024. Don't be on phone in lecture; just focus on the content. Mandatory Iclicker for an attendance grade. Homework was long, but I think it's the same no matter which professor you take. His exam reviews are lifesavers, plus he has a Youtube channel for explaining content. Very caring professor even if he doesn't show it.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Guys this is ....

This was my 2nd time taking Ochem, 1st time I got a D (dif prof), and with Dr. G I got an A. He gives homework that is actually useful, practice exams, and YouTube vids that he makes that were the most helpful to me. His lectures are very good, keep you engaged and he is just very good at explaining Ochem which obv is not an easy course. Take him!!

Dr. G is funny, nice, smart, and fair. The best part of his 119 class I found was his youtube account and study guide videos. He goes through a mock exam before each test and the actualy test is the same exact format with different numbers. Not only does this make your life easier, but you still learn the material. I hope I get him for O Chem!

Dr. G is one of the best professors I've ever had, and 100% the best in his department. He cares about his students, and his lectures are engaging and very entertaining. He is extremely clear about what will be on the exams, and you can definitely get a good grade if you go to lecture, do the homework, and study. You'll actually learn in his class!

Dr. G is the best!! He is so kind and caring towards students and seriously wants you to succeed. Practice tests are so similar to actual exams. Watch his videos and you will do fine! I got 60s on two exams but still got an A because he drops the lowest test.

Dr G was fantastic! As long as you go to class and watch his videos (do lots of practice problems) his tests won't be too difficult. All tests were fairly straightforward, with no surprise questions and he really cares about helping students learn! 10/10 recommend

Dr G is honestly an amazing professor I understood orgo literally thanks to him! His videos are really helpful as long as you do all the work and watch his videos you should be good! He looks like he'd be mean but he really does care for his students! Definitely recommend will take him for orgo 2👍🏻
Dr. G is a G! He is always willing to answer questions in office hours and his youtube videos are generally very helpful!

Dr. G was an amazing professor! I was really scared to take organic chemistry and he made it better! He gives practice tests for each test and review videos for each unit. His practice tests are similar to the actual test and he tends to give partial credit since the tests aren't multiple choice. Attendance is highly recommended!

Dr. G has a unique sense of humor, but he cares about his students and their success. He likes to point out concepts that may show up on pre-professional exams, he posts videos about challenging topics and these videos contain many examples and are easy to follow. His lectures are easy to follow even though the material is tough.
Dr. G was great. The class is definitely a difficult one but he has a youtube channel that is very useful and gives exam reviews that are similar. Tests are still hard but he is helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His exams were nearly identical to his reviews and his Youtube channel was extremely helpful (Shoutout OrgTube). The homework takes some time but overall it is really helpful in helping you learn the material. He isn't the best lecturer but he wants to see his students succeed and making an A is not hard. So excited to hopefully get him for OChem!

After taking a few weeks of CHEM120 with a bad prof, I'm here to say that Dr.G is the best professor for chemistry. He makes his exams easy and you actually are able to learn the content. I hated on him a bit just because he was rude when I asked for help, but he is otherwise a really good professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Beginning was tough, but he ended up being one of my favorite prof. He is so funny and engages w the class a lot. His study guides are amazing, I would go through them 2-3 times for exams & it really helped my scores (F's to B+s). Just do the ALEKS and study guides and you'll pass. I'm basing my entire next semester on having him be my OCHEM prof.

Very good professor, makes lots of review videos on his personal youtube video that are extremely similar to his exams, he's very well spoken and makes the class extremely easy with his humorous analogies and he's VERY well educated on the subject. He was so good I intentionally chose to take him again when I saw he's teaching CHEM257 this spring.

Dr. G isn't the most interesting lecturer, but he makes his class easy to succeed in. His test reviews are almost exactly like his tests, and they're very helpful. Attendance is important, and iClicker is an easy grade booster as long as you attend class. The Aleks homework is sometimes very time-consuming. Overall an okay class.

Dr. Ghanbaripour was very clear on his expectations from the first day of class. No extra credit or curves, but as long as you do the review it is usually ok. Lots of studying required, but the homework is easy.

Dr. G was great! He does have an accent but he was still easy to understand. Attendance is apart of your grade so go to class as much as you can! Also, his YouTube channel (OrgTube) is incredibly helpful.

Dr. G is my favorite professor at A&M. My exam 1 grade was a 60. I immediately met with Dr. G who walked me through each mistake and assured me I could do well in his class. (I did.) He is very encouraging, hilarious, and hella smart. Definitely take one of his classes if you can. I am not STEM-minded, but Dr. G made me really enjoy chemistry.
Best professor I've ever taken
He posts youtube reviews that are just like the exam, funny guy and wants everyone to succeed, labs are more tedious than the class, very doable A as long as you try in the lab

Dr. G is amazing! I took the class and ended up with an 89.86, but he rounded it up to an A! Go to every lecture, complete ALL assignments, and introduce yourself. You'll do great as long as you work hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. G is the best professor I had this semester! He is great at lecturing and teaching the course content, the exam reviews were basically the same as the actual content on the exams. Only reason I didn't get an A is because I didn't study in first half of semester. I would definitely take him again if I could!!
Best prof ever! I had the pleasure of taking Dr.G and I wish he could follow me through all my chem classes! Do the reviews, and hw and you'll make an A
Best professor I have had! Went from hating chemistry to loving it! Very good teacher who cares about his students.

a good choice for chem. only went to lecture for iClicker points and taught myself material outside of class. has really good reviews for the tests. the only negative thing abt him is that he is very clear/ kinda harsh abt not bothering him abt your grade or any extra credit. dont rely on there being a curve. i got my hopes up abt my 89.4 curving:(

Dr. G is a funny guy and entertaining but his lectures leave quite a bit to be desired. While they do go over most of the content you need to know, you might leave class without a great understanding of the topic if it is completely new to you. Luckily the tests are incredibly easy and he writes reviews that are pretty much a 1 to 1 to the test.

TAKE THIS CLASS. Dr. G is an amazing prof and makes lectures so entertaining. He posts extra videos for topics and the test reviews. He does have an accent but you'll def get used to it. You only need 70% on Iclicker to get full points but go to class as he sometimes gives you specific examples to work on for the test!

Very nice and funny professor. He isn't the best at explaining some of the concepts so you will need to learn on your own for certain topics. He gives study guides for the tests which help out a lot. At the end of the semester he gives out a lot of extra points for certain things. Class isn't too hard as long as you try to study a little bit
Dr. G was great! He rounds up hw if your average is 90% and above. Ickicker grades also get rounded to a 100% if above a 70%. Tests are just like the review sheet and his YouTube videos are helpful!!

Chem 119 has been the bane of my existence during college. This is my third time taking it and Dr. G not only gave me the knowledge and power to pass, but to get a decent B. Rashid seriously gives his students every opportunity to succeed while also grasping the concepts, with reviews that are similar to the tests. Over all, fantastic teacher.

This was the first chemistry class I have ever taken and Dr. G made the transition easier for me. He is very compassionate and you can tell he cares about his students. He makes videos consistently to help us catch up. Overall very well rounded professor!
This was my first chemistry class, and Dr. G made the transition easier. He is very compassionate and cares about his students. He makes videos consistently and makes it easier for us to catch up.

I liked Dr. G a lot, very funny in class which made lectures enjoyable. In the beginning, he read off the slides but got better as the semester went on. Chem was never my thing but the class is set up with many safety nets to help your grade. Test reviews are very similar to the test so always do those. Strong accent if that bothers you.

Chemistry is hard for me, but Dr. G didnt make it complicated. It was easier than AP chem in HS. Test are really short, so make sure to know everything 100%. He is funny in lecture tho. You have to show up to get attendance credit. Study and show up. It is doable even though I struggled.

This professor was hilarious and charismatic during class time. He posts YouTube videos to provide additional help for his students during the semester which were extremely helpful. He makes chemistry more enjoyable if you do not already enjoy it. Homework is also very doable and gives that extra practice.

He is one of the best professors I've had. I would take him again if I could. He is nice, caring, and explains chemistry pretty well (as someone who failed high school chemistry). His youtube channel is extremely helpful. Lab was the hardest part of the class for me.

The only people who will dislike Dr G are mouth breathers. Dr G is literally the goat and this class was so fun and easy because of him. I will miss his dubious smile. If you have taken chemistry before you will be chilling in this class.

Explained everything really well and was a funny professor but his accent is pretty thick and can be difficult to understand when talking about some of the more complex topics. Responded to emails slowly but loved the YouTube videos that helped explain a lot.
He is amazing. Its just a harder class but he does very well explaining everything.

Dr. G is a fun professor, he knows what he is talking about and gives short cuts to thing which I find very helpful. Sometimes he goes over concepts a little too quickly but the ALEKS helps with that. He also makes youtube videos explaining the harder concepts which is really nice. Overall a funny, and caring guy.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Great professor, great at teaching and always seems happy to be there. His practice test are almost identical to his real test and if you study those you will do fine. Follow his youtube and instagram @orgtube.

He is honestly such a funny and caring professor. I thought his lectures were pretty good and he has a LOT of supplemental materials to help. He posts a lot of lecture and review videos which are very helpful. His exam reviews are practically the same as the exams so if you do well on those, you will do well on the exams.

Any negative comments about this guy are from students who do not put in the work for the class.  He is funny, caring, always at office hours, and takes his own time to make supplemental material for his students. Pay attention to the practice problems in class. Do your Aleks and study the test review! I got a B from bad lab grades, not Dr. G.

TAKE PROFESSOR G!! He is literally the best. He made all the topics very easy to understand and always was there to help if you didn't understand. He cares for everyone and wants everyone to do their best. As a freshmen coming into chemistry I was a little worried that it would be hard for me but he made it very manageable and was super organized.

I took Dr. Ghanbaripour for Chem 119, and I would 100% take him again, hopefully for organic. I had to do a little self-studying outside of class for his exams, but Dr. Ghanbaripour created very useful exam study guides that are EXTREMELY similar to the actual exams. Also, his YouTube videos on his channel, OrgTube, were very helpful!

He is super knowledgeable about everything. He enjoys talking to the students, but be ready to work because he forces you to learn, which is helpful. The only thing is that it's pretty clear that he likes teaching OChem more because he sometimes stops to talk about concepts we don't need, but even then it's still good information for the future.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. G is very knowledgeable and helpful. The reviews he creates for his exams are very similar to the actual exams, and his YouTube videos are helpful for understanding course content. The class is designed for students to do well if you actually pay attention and access the materials he posts for you.

As someone who didn't take AP chem, his class is great. He's interactive with everyone and does iClicker so attendance is mandatory. He has good humor and honestly, the large amt of homework (ALEKS) really helps because practice makes me understand the concepts better. His videos are literally godsend, literally life-changing. ATTEND THIS CLASS!!

He is by far the worst professor I have ever had. He is rude, unhelpful and unfunny. It's clear he does not want to teach this class as he only reads off the slides and says we should already know the material. Also, homework never coincides with lectures. The only good thing about him is that the reviews are nearly identical to the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He funny, Homework is super easy (if you dont know how to do it you can see a very similar example), weekly. You have to purchase something for the homework, and more for lab. Lab sucked but thats unrelated to him. Tests are veryyy similar to reviews. Probably easier because I took AP Chem in highschool tho.

The absolute best chem professor. Lectures were very clear and engaging. Lots of iclickers for extra credit but you only need 70% of them to get the full credit. Very understanding and considerate of his students. He makes review videos and practice exams that are extremely helpful and make it easy to earn an A, I love him!
He's funny but his lectures cover a lot of stuff. Would highly recommend attending SI sessions. Overall, good guy. Wish I could take him again for CHEM 120.
Prof G, is really good. Just beware, he does i-clicker for a grade every class. The practice tests are identical to the actual tests. Very clear and explanatory lectures

Professor G. was amazing. Aside from his lectures, he also provides YouTube videos that makes it easier for students to grasp the materials. Chem is hard in general, but I would recommend Dr. G as a professor. He is funny and caring. You will just have to study a lot for this class.

Took him for both organic I and II and did well in both. Attend class and watch the videos he make, they explain reactions so well. Reviews are similar to the exams but don't try to memorize the reviews, actually know the concepts. Professor will answer any questions, so don't be afraid to ask them. This class still requires a lot of studying.

Was a wonderful professor had him for both semesters of Organic chemistry and is very open to answering any questions, along with posting videos for important concepts needed for the course. He provides all the resources needed to be successful for the course and exams were average in difficulty.
